title: *NSYNC website, 2000
lede: The boy band’s Flash intro of August 2000: a wavy blue panel with a wide slanted logo, its mirror reflection, glowing blue orbs, and a member portrait in a halo.
summary: Wavy blue panel, wide slanted NSYNC logo with a mirror reflection, glossy blue orb corners, and a portrait in a glowing ring.

evidence.note: Captured from the Internet Archive with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 and inspected. The main panel is Flash content, which rendered in the capture. Nothing covers the page.

styles.note: Clear: glossy orbs, a floor reflection, wide slanted techno lettering, a glowing halo, a blob-edged panel, and speed lines with a star. The page draws its graphics with images, so the CSS fingerprint measures flat, square, unshadowed boxes (see the style page). Judge it by the rubric.

observed: The page background is flat teal-blue. A large panel of brighter blue with soft, wavy edges and rounded corners fills the center.
Four glossy dark-blue orbs with white highlights sit at the panel corners like rivets.
The logo is a big italic “N” with “SYNC” in wide, slanted, outlined capitals; a mirror image of the logo appears below, as on a glossy floor.
A member’s photo sits in a circle with a violet glow and a white lens-flare highlight; his name “CHRIS” is in light-blue italic capitals.
A purple star and horizontal speed lines sit behind the portrait. A red star with speed lines marks the “skip…” link.
Below the panel, a glossy black oval button reads “Get *NSYNC”, next to a plain email form and a Shockwave badge.
interpretation: This intro gathers many Y2K web devices in one frame: orb buttons, a mirror reflection, glow halos, lens flare, wide slanted type, and speed lines.
The pixel palette is almost all saturated blue (chromatic share 0.97). The CSS measurement sees only the plain HTML around the Flash.
borrow: Put a mirror reflection of a wide logo under it on a glossy panel.
Use glossy orbs with one white highlight as corner rivets or buttons.
Circle a portrait with a soft colored glow instead of a border.

images.alt: Archived *NSYNC intro: on teal-blue, a wavy bright-blue panel with glossy blue orbs at its corners, the NSYNC logo in wide slanted capitals with a mirror reflection, a member portrait in a glowing violet ring with a star and speed lines, and a skip link.
